visual_text: Dementia with Lewy bodies: core features
Does alertness or thinking vary a lot?
Does the person see people or animals that are not there?
Do they act out dreams in sleep?
Are they slow, stiff or tremulous?
Any yes: think of Lewy body disease and get specialist advice first. A teaching prompt, not a diagnosis.
Core features: McKeith et al., Neurology 2017. Antipsychotic caution: NICE NG97. Advice to ask for specialist input is ours.
alt_text: Checklist of four questions before an antipsychotic, for dementia with Lewy bodies: does alertness vary a lot, does the person see people or animals not there, do they act out dreams, are they slow, stiff or tremulous. Each has an empty tick box and a line icon. Any yes: think of Lewy body disease and get specialist advice first. A teaching prompt, not a diagnosis.
